title: Exact products for arbitrary pro-etale module objects
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $B$ an arbitrary monoid object in abelian sheaves on $X_{\mathrm{proét}}$. For every small index set $I$, products of shape $I$ are exact in $\operatorname{Mod}(\operatorname{Ab}(X_{\mathrm{proét}}),B)$ [det-pe-products-exact]. No commutativity of $B$ is required.

source.place: Proof (2), transfer of det-pe-products-exact to the module-object coefficient encoding

proof.text: For T the tensor unit in abelian sheaves, the unit axiom forces every T-module action to be the left unitor. Thus the forgetful functor is fully faithful; free T-modules and the unitor prove essential surjectivity. Apply the existing section-module equivalence for the commutative monoid T. Exact products for the reconstructed ring sheaf follow from det-pe-products-exact, and transport through the composite equivalence yields exact products of abelian sheaves.

The module-object forgetful functor for arbitrary B creates products, preserves finite colimits, and reflects finite colimits since it is exact and conservative. Pull back exactness of discrete limits along it using Mathlib HasExactLimitsOfShape.domain_of_functor. No commutative structure on B occurs.

theorem proEtale_moduleObject_products_exact (X : Scheme.{u})
    (B : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj B]

    HasExactLimitsOfShape (Discrete I)
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) B)
